blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – The Mandaue City Government is preparing a Fantasy Land-themed Christmas display with an estimated budget of ₱10 million to ₱12 million, featuring expanded decorations across the city. Mayor Thadeo Jovito “Jonkie” Ouano said that preparations for the event were 80 percent complete as of Friday, November 20. City officials and employees are gearing up for the annual Christmas lighting ceremony on Monday, November 23. The mayor said that the Christmas display is meant to provide residents with a place where families and friends can gather, stroll around, and spend time together during the holiday season.
